# CloudCode — Comprehensive Architectural & Feature Documentation

> CloudCode is a next-generation Cloud Development Environment (CDE) platform that allows developers to edit, build, run, debug, and preview full-stack applications directly from mobile devices and web browsers.

---

## 1. Overview & Vision
CloudCode replicates a native PC software engineering experience on mobile devices by running isolated Docker containers on Virtual Private Server (VPS) infrastructure and dynamically proxying HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket traffic to mobile clients.

Key architectural pillars:
- **Zero Local Footprint:** All code execution, compilation, containerization, and file storage occur in high-performance cloud environments.
- **50ms Latency PTY Shell:** Custom WebSocket bridge multiplexing terminal commands to Node.js `node-pty` processes inside containerized Linux environments.
- **Mobile-Engineered UX:** Custom touch gestures, responsive monospaced code editing, quick snippet bars, and instant mobile preview port forwards.

---

## 2. Technical Stack & Supported Tools

### Runtimes & Languages
CloudCode supports any runtime supported by standard Linux Docker images:
- **JavaScript / TypeScript:** Node.js, Bun, Deno, Vite, Next.js, React, Express.
- **Python:** Python 3.10+, Django, Flask, FastApi, Pip.
- **Compiled Languages:** Go, Rust, C / C++ (GCC/Clang), Java (JDK / Maven / Gradle).
- **Other Environments:** Ruby, PHP, Elixir, Haskell.

### Development Tools
- **Package Managers:** npm, yarn, pnpm, bun, pip, cargo, apt.
- **Version Control:** Git version control over SSH and HTTPS, visual diffing, branch creation, pull request reviews.
- **AI Engine:** Integrated AI assistant supporting code generation, bug fixing, test generation, and project-wide context awareness.

---

## 3. Security & Container Isolation
- Every project operates in an isolated Docker container with strict CPU (e.g. 512m) and RAM (1GB) bounds.
- Non-root user privileges inside workspace containers.
- Container auto-sleep after 30 minutes of inactivity to save compute, with sub-5-second automatic wake-up on request.
- Encrypted transport via SSL/TLS 1.3 for all web and WebSocket connections.
